questions.question: Did a DOM PASS substitute for actual whole-screenshot inspection?
questions.answer: No. I opened each of the four exact screenshots once with view_image and inspected from heading to bottom link. DOM and HTML only supplied binding and layout context.

questions.answer: Yes. Both mobile shots show the full 2.14 equation/number, cosine formula, final amplitude fraction, upright m and complete figure labels. Both desktop shots show the same content without collisions or clipped ends.

questions.answer: No. Exactly four display screenshots were opened. D062's review freeze was read and hash-bound, with no new scientific, translation, source or figure-fidelity judgment.

questions.answer: No. This is first independent review of existing headless offline screenshots only. No browser, capture, render, finalize, test or native validator was run.

questions.answer: No. The semantic premise is D064's independent pixel finding of U+002E sentence periods at 27 exact locations. I judge the displayed textual before/after codepoints against those findings and combine that affected PASS with D064's unaffected PASS findings. The script only supplies exact-position equality and immutable hash bindings.
